messages.content:
Execute the acquired semantic reading operations on the CURRENT
source windows. All operation meanings, alternatives and examples are learned
assets, not current-source facts. Classify the operation's actual question;
do not answer a downstream task or copy an old example's choice. Preserve who
acts, the legal modality, trigger, scope and qualifications. A heading, mention
or hypothetical event is not automatically an operative duty or permission.
Return exactly one answer for every supplied query ID. Select a declared choice
or "unknown". Missing information is unknown, never an implicit negative.
For every non-unknown choice, quote the actual current words supporting that
classification, inside the query's supplied unit IDs. Quotes may fold whitespace
but may not change words. Negative alternatives also need actual evidence; mere
absence is insufficient unless the declared operation explicitly asks whether
something appears in the complete supplied window. No extra IDs or fields.

and", "source": "ContractNLI:d9360f2a8c03efc35524289167a83e9505ebae476367505b868af29f37fcffa0"}, {"choice": "named_service_actor", "quote": "Volunteer further agrees that upon termination of service with CCPDT, Volunteer shall return within ten (10) business days all documents, files, electronic or otherwise, and property comprising Confidential Information of CCPDT and all copies, electronic or otherwise, thereof relating in any way to the Certification Council for Professional Dog Trainers’ business, or in any way obtained during the course of service.", "source": "ContractNLI:354623271a5433b9d6fe42ec70538acd25e9f7e37aee568c81e2e7d4912f9450"}, {"choice": "holder_and_its_representatives", "quote": "Upon termination of this Agreement, all Confidential Information in the possession or control of a Participating Entity and its Representatives that received such information shall be returned to the Participating Entity that disclosed the information, including all copies of such information in any form whatsoever, unless otherwise instructed in writing by the Participating Entity that disclosed the information.", "source": "ContractNLI:442c36c12745965b79f777dedc7bc3dc249d80ca444c395ece6ec7953c15c07f"}, {"choice": "no_disposal_retention_actor", "quote": "(b) notwithstanding completion of the Purpose or return of documents and materials as aforesaid, continue to be bound by the undertakings set out in clause 2.", "source": "ContractNLI:d9360f2a8c03efc35524289167a83e9505ebae476367505b868af29f37fcffa0"}], "name": "disposal_retention_actor_role", "question": "Which source-designated participant bears the operative disposal or retention effect in these units? Resolve the participant role without deciding the downstream legal task."}], "current_queries": [{"id": "sr_3_actor", "operation": "disposal_retention_actor_role", "unit_ids": [30], "current_units": [{"id": 30, "text": "Volunteer further agrees that no copies, electronic or otherwise, notes or abstracts of the foregoing shall be retained and that all information will be returned not destroyed."}]}]}
